name: Reijougari
source:
Rena asks protagonist to wear her clothes and infiltrate her academy in order to remain the only virgin candidate and win in the academy competition.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
蕾娜要求主角穿上她的衣服并潜入她的学院，以保持唯一的处女候选人并在学院竞赛中获胜。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
